SELECT "q"."w" "w", "q"."c" "c" 
FROM (
  SELECT "wk"."cast_floor_dated" "w", "wk"."measure_wk_n_" "c" 
  FROM (
    SELECT CAST(FLOOR((CASE WHEN LOWER('day') IN ('year', 'quarter', 'month') THEN (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE_TRUNC('day', ("wk".ts::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')), DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamptz '2001-01-07T00:00:00.000Z'))) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(DATE_TRUNC('day', ("wk".ts::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')), DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamptz '2001-01-07T00:00:00.000Z')))) / CASE LOWER('day') WHEN 'year' THEN 12 WHEN 'quarter' THEN 3 WHEN 'month' THEN 1 END ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM DATE_TRUNC('day', ("wk".ts::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) - DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamptz '2001-01-07T00:00:00.000Z')) / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '1 day'::interval) END::bigint / 7)) AS BIGINT) "cast_floor_dated", count("wk".id) "measure_wk_n_" 
    FROM  audit.wk  AS "wk"
    WHERE ((("wk".ts::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= timestamptz '2025-01-05T00:00:00.000Z'))
    GROUP BY 1
  ) AS "wk"
  ORDER BY "wk"."cast_floor_dated" ASC NULLS LAST
) AS "q"
LIMIT 50000
